description: This file defines an internal class `AdoNetStreamQueueMapper` that maps Orleans stream and queue identifiers to ADO.NET queue identifiers, utilizing caching for efficiency and external mapper for retrieval.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Internal class for mapping Orleans streams and queues to ADO.NET queue identifiers, including caching mechanisms.

methods.name: GetAdoNetQueueId
methods.description: Returns the ADO.NET queue identifier for a given StreamId or QueueId, utilizing cached lookups for performance.

methods.name: GetAllAdoNetQueueIds
methods.description: Yields all ADO.NET Queue IDs in the current space by retrieving and caching them.
